title: Disconnection of the power supply - Edit

storage.value:
User Story

 

As a system user

I want to be able to update Disconnection of the power supply's data

So that I will have possibility to correct my mistake

 

Design: Disconnection_Of_The_Power_Supply (adobe.com)

Acceptance criteria:

  1. Check system user permissions to see edit icon on disconnection of the power supply's listing/detail page. If no such permission, edit icon will be disabled

    1. Edit Draft Disconnection of the power supply

      1. Allows to edit all Disconnection of the power supply' objects with status Draft

    2. Edit Executed Disconnection of the power supply

      1. Allows to edit all Disconnection of the power supply’s objects with status Executed

  2. Clicking on an edit icon on listing/detail page will allow edit mode

  3. All fields are editable with the regular flow if status is Draft

  4. For Executed objects it is possible to edit only:

    1. File for import

    2. Type of disconnection

    3. Date of disconnection

    4. Express reconnection

    5. Files - to be able to upload

  5. When Draft object is opened for editing the table with PODs should be updated

  6. When Executed object is opened for editing only selected PODs should be displayed in the table

  7. When Executed object is opened for editing Save and Cancel buttons should be visible

  8. Task's sub-object should be enable and optional in both flows - when object is Draft or Executed

    1. Clicking on Plus button will open Task' creation page where Disconnection of the power supply object should be already set as a sub-object

    2. Separate editing

    3. After creating a Task and clicking on Refresh button, newly created task should be set with the following logic:

      1. Task number-Creation date-Task type

    4. It is possible to click already added record or an arrow and system should open task's page in new browser window

    5. It is possible to remove already added task from the Disconnection of the power supply object

  9. 'Save as a draft' button (available only if status is Draft)

    1. Enable if user has such permission

    2. Disabled if user does not have such permission

    3. Clicking on Save as a draft button will check all the validations (frontend and backend)

      1. If all the validation are successful, then system should save changed

      2. If frontend validations are not successful, system should display an error message with proper field

      3. If an error happens in backend, system should display an error message retrieved from the backend

    4. When object is created as a Draft and it is not executed yet, however, user creates identical Disconnection of the power supply object, should display all PODs

  10. ‘Save and Execute’ button (available only if status is Draft)

    1. Enable if user has such permission

    2. Disabled if user does not have such permission

    3. Clicking on Save and Execute button will check all the validations (frontend and backend)

      1. If all the validations are successful, then system should save changes and change status to Executed

      2. If frontend validations are not successful, system should display an error message with proper field

      3. If an error happens in backend, system should display an error message retrieved from the backend

    4. System should generate documents according selected templates and save them in Files

    5. After Executed PODs and relevant customers should be marked as Disconnected in DB

      1. If PODs are reconnected, such PODs and relevant customer should be unmarked as disconnected in the DB

    6. After executed system should check for each POD included in the disconnection is the Type of disconnection the same as in the Request for power supply disconnection.

      1. If type of disconnection is different the system should check in the Tax for the new Type of disconnection has different amount.

        1. If the amount is different, such tax should be cancelled and system should create a new tax with the correct amount for the respective customer

    7. After executed system should check for each POD included in the disconnection is the checkbox Express reconnection marked.

      1. For such PODs the system should create a new tax for Express reconnection according to Grid operator tax nomenclature.

    8. If in the Grid operator tax nomenclature a tax is with amount 0 such tax should not be created

    9. The user must be able to save disconnection changes when Express reconnection is selected and the tax amount is 0

    10. When user executed the object and created another Disconnection of the power supply object for the same grid operator, should display non-reconnected PODs only

  11. Save button (available only if status is Executed)

    1. Enabled if user has such permission

    2. Disabled if user does not have such permission

    3. Clicking on Save button will check all the validations (frontend and backend)

      1. If frontend validations are not successful, system should display an error message with proper field

      2. If an error happens in backend, system should display an error message retrieved from the backend

    4. After successful save, system should check for each POD included in the disconnection is the Type of disconnection the same as in the Request for power supply disconnection.

      1. If type of disconnection is different the system should check is the Tax for the new Type of disconnection has different amount.

        1. If the amount is different, such tax should be cancelled and system should create a new tax with the correct amount for the respective customer

    5. After successful save system should check for each POD included in the disconnection if the checkbox Express reconnection marked.

      1. For such PODs the system should create a new tax for Express reconnection according to Grid operator tax nomenclature

    6. If in the Grid operator tax nomenclature a tax is with amount 0 such tax should not be created

  12. When clicking on 'Cancel' or 'X' button should check changes and if there are changes made then warning pop-up message comes out with buttons: 'Your changes are not saved, are you sure you want to cancel?' Yes/No

    1. Yes - will close Disconnection of the power supply's editing page and return to listing page

    2. No - will close warning pop-up and stay on Disconnection of the power supply's editing page

    3. Warning message should be managed from the system settings

  13. Audit Log record should be created

Customer Feedbacks: https://oppa-support.atlassian.net/browse/PDT-2880

https://oppa-support.atlassian.net/browse/PDT-2782
